description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to build and maintain internal applications that support business operations and improve workflow efficiency.


Responsibilities:
  • Develop and maintain applications using .NET Core and Windows Forms.
  • Build front-end and back-end components and middleware integrations.
  • Integrate applications with databases, APIs, and third-party services.
  • Optimize performance, scalability, and security.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and follow best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and Agile processes.
  • Contribute across the full software development lifecycle.


Requirements:
  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role.
  • Strong knowledge of C#, .NET Core, and Windows Forms.
  • Experience with SQL databases (SQL Server/PostgreSQL).
  • Understanding of REST APIs and software architecture.
  • Experience with Git and Agile (Scrum, Jira).
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.


Nice to Have:
  • Experience with Android, Kotlin, or Entity Framework.
  • Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, or Azure.


Benefits:
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Impactful internal projects.
  • Collaborative work environment.
  • Hybrid work schedule.
